attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Occupational Therapy Governing Board (Office of Professional Licensure and Certification)

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least half clinical (directly related to the clinical application of OT); the rest on general OT theory and practice (supervision, consultation, curriculum development, trans-disciplinary skills). On-site or distance learning: academic and AOTA-approved courses, conferences, workshops; facility in-service; informal and mentored independent study; fieldwork supervision; employer peer review; publications; presentations; research; specialty certifications (e.g. CHT, NDT); product development; board/committee work; CPR certification; universal precautions education (limits per activity in Occ 406.04–406.17).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial license issued January 1 – August 31 of an odd-numbered year: 6 contact hours for the first renewal; initial license issued in an even-numbered year: full 24.
rules.alternatives: Maintaining current NBCOT certification fulfils the whole requirement (copy of the NBCOT certificate as documentation).
rules.audit_note: Universal Application for License Renewal (Plc 308); CE documentation and audits follow Plc 308.04.
rules.legal_basis: N.H. Code Admin. R. Occ 406.01–406.17; Occ 402 (readopted eff. 3-13-26); RSA 326-C:6
rules.notes: 24 contact hours per biennium. Part Occ 400 was readopted with amendments effective March 13, 2026 (renewal procedure now under OPLC Plc 308); the continuing-competence rules in Occ 406 (eff. 7-26-22) still set the hours.
